g.text: Max reads raw grids → coordinates for irregular tables

svg.text: Three recovery rounds · Jev · DeepSeek · Max
three rounds unrecovered → evidence-based discard · no human review
discards reversible & ledger-logged · decisions reused next run

g.text: source evidence vs output per folder / column / sheet / row
covered · irrelevant → exclude · gap → tiered recovery
deterministic → Flash locate → Max review → verified patch
Row qc_flag 3: out of range · 4: pending review
Analysis set: value pass/outlier_flagged + year gate
